reason: Release 39: #2014 (claude/mesh-batch-c): Creature meshes, batch C (docs/plans/creature-mesh-rollout.md; Ed, 2026-11-13: "The mesh builders work is good enough, please merge it when submitted."): the six hoofed kinds, stag, elk, roe, ram, ibex and boar, are drawn from low-poly meshes on skeletons (art/mesh/species/<id>.js, with hooves, antlers, horns and tusks new in art/mesh/kit) in place of today's drawings, at today's drawn heights (Ed, 2026-11-12: "keep the sizes"), on eight-frame walks and runs with planted feet. No kind changes its id, its island or its numbers, so the rules are untouched.

frames.*: wherever a stag, elk, roe, ram, ibex or boar is in view: its new drawing (slimmer bodies, since antlers and horns count in the height), its walk's and run's frames and how fast they pass, where it is drawn along its way (up to a step behind), the frame it stops on, its sleeping pose, and what hangs over it by its height
